answer: Miscellaneous >> History & Biography Question ID: 1917 Country: United States of America Title: Can Shaikh Safraz Khan Safdar be reffered to as "Muhaqqiq ul Asr"? Who are other Muhaqqiqs of yor time? Question: Salam O Alaikum, Can Shaikh Safraz Khan Safdar be reffered to as "Muhaqqiq ul Asr"? Who are other Muhaqqiqs of yor time? Answer ID: 1917 Posted on: Aug 30, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 716/712=N) Hazrat Maulana Sarfaraaz Khan Safdar has a number of research (tahgeeqi) books and academic achievements; if he is given a title of Muhaqqiul Asr it is not objectionable. There are Muhaqqiqs other than him as well in the world. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
